narrative: Urgent message claiming your social account will be suspended.

message.body: URGENT: Copyright violation reported on your post. Your account will be DELETED in 15 minutes unless you appeal at http://social-copyright-appeal.net

evidence.label: In-App Support Inbox
evidence.value: Support inbox shows zero copyright violations or warnings.

consequence_text.safe: Checking your in-app support inbox revealed no copyright notices.
consequence_text.unsafe: Entering credentials on fake appeal sites leads to account takeover.

teaching_point: Official copyright warnings appear in your account's in-app support center, never via random text messages.
